newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Marco Polo withdraws 59 unsold Singapore units.
newsitem.headline: Marco Polo withdraws 59 unsold Singapore units.

text.p: Singapore-listed firm Marco Polo Developments Ltd has withdrawn 59 unsold units in its 330-unit Ardmore Park complex and would offer them at a higher price later, its executive director said on Saturday.
"We are not in a hurry to sell," David Lawrence told Reuters.
"We would hold the units for a couple of years and would release them in small tranches as and when we can achieve a higher price," he said.
Lawrence's comments come after a Straits Time newspaper report on Saturday which said the company had withdrawn the units because it had failed to find buyers.
Marco Polo Developments subsidiary, MP-Bilt Ltd started a soft launch of the 330-unit Ardmore Park, located in the island's prestigious Orchard Road area, on June 24.
To date, the company had sold 271 units for Singapore $1.5 billion, giving a total take up rate of 82 percent.
Lawrence said the company expected the property market in Singapore to recover in the second half of 1997 and may consider offering the remaining units then.
